text:
maya: Heads-up: a bunch of quantized-eval traces from last night aren't in the archive index. Ran the coverage query and seeing holes. Anyone else see missing index rows? :eyes:
juan: Which example key do you have? can you paste one quick so I can troubleshoot infra logs?
maya: example key: archives/2026-03-19/quant-run-qs/part-0007.tr.gz — manifest header for sample 8271 shows schema v2 but no index row. snippet:
```json
{"sample_id":"8271","shard":"part-0007","schema":"v2","trace_key":"archives/2026-03-19/quant-run-qs/part-0007.tr.gz"}
```
ci-bot: runner-ci: job eval-runner-upload failed — uploader:manifest-emission (build 3421) :warning:
henry: Could be multipart upload race. If uploader writes manifest before multipart complete, indexer might skip the file. Any `CompleteMultipartUpload` vs `PutObject` entries in logs?
sophia: Also saw retention-pruner run ~02:15 UTC and it pruned the same shard range. If uploader/manifest used local time and indexer used UTC, we could have a window where indexer writes after pruning.
ops-bot: retention-pruner executed: deleted 18 objects, window=2026-03-18T02:15:12Z..2026-03-18T02:15:20Z
liz: Temporary mitigation: there's a reindex tool at infra/tools/reindex_traces.py. Usage:
```
python reindex_traces.py --prefix archives/2026-03-19/quant-run-qs --dry-run
```
juan: Long term: make manifest emission transactional with index row. Minimal change: emit index row as part of the same DB tx or write a durable ack before retention sees it.
maya: This is mainly hitting quantized bring-up runs, about ~1200 samples missing. Dashboard shows coverage drop for quantized-v2 compared to baseline.
henry: Quick check you can run: `aws s3api list-objects --bucket redwood-artifacts --prefix archives/2026-03-19/quant-run-qs | jq '.Contents[].Key'` then feed keys to reindexer.
sophia: I can run the backfill tonight after we deploy the patch. Estimate ~30m for reindex+checksum verification.
maya: Please coordinate timing — don't run reindex while batch-uploader is active, risk double-write TTL churn. Use the locker: `locker.acquire('reindex-quant-20260319')`
ops-bot: scheduled maintenance: storage-indexer will restart at 03:00 UTC for config reload.
juan: I'll open a small PR to make manifest emission atomic + add a unit/integration test that asserts index exists after manifest success.
maya: Summary / action items: 1) juan PR for transactional emit, 2) sophia runs backfill tonight (30m), 3) ops to block uploads during backfill, 4) run reindex dry-run now and sane-run after patch. I'll file bug 4621 with reproducer and attach the sample list. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
